question: Does the paper provide any case studies to illustrate how one can use Macaw for CIS research?
title: Macaw: An Extensible Conversational Information Seeking Platform
answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 10 explicitly mention that Macaw supports Wizard of Oz studies and intermediary-based information seeking studies, which can simulate ideal CIS systems and collect high-quality user interaction data for CIS research. This directly illustrates how one can use Macaw for CIS research through such case studies.
